items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: Frank Driggs wrote and told me something... Driggs will ask a question... I'll answer them there.

ctx.x: Well a lot of guys had to work in the street and I think that you have to develop strength and tone and everything there.

So I was, I meant to ask you something Dick. Frank Driggs wrote and told me something and he says, well I have a different story from you than what Dick Allen says. I said, man I'd like to know what it is. He said, because everything I've told Dick is from my own chops.
